name: IPAM / RIR / CRM baseline
contributes: Intended scopes, prefixes, pools and allocations with owner, purpose and route-announcement policy metadata.
adapter_note: Consumed as a versioned candidate batch; the seeded local ledger is the only active baseline today. A changed intended batch stays staged and cannot silently overwrite an approved local allocation.
access_note: Read-only exported records. No live registry, RIR or CRM API is connected; the repository carries a synthetic baseline only.

name: DHCP lease events
contributes: Lease validity intervals that bind an address to an opaque client identity over time.
adapter_note: A synthetic importer accepts versioned lease-interval batches. No live DHCP server, lease database or event stream is connected.
access_note: Read-only import. A complete eligible window is required for absence-based candidates; an incomplete or stale batch cannot prove no usage.

name: BMP routing state
contributes: Observed route presence and validity intervals per scope, address family and prefix.
unlocks: positive route presence for zombie-style review
adapter_note: The routing fixture is a synthetic bounded route-state export, not a BMP collector and not an event/withdraw parser. A real adapter would subscribe to BMP and normalize messages into intervals; it does not exist.
access_note: Read-only telemetry. A stale or incomplete routing view yields unknown, never unused or stranded.

name: CMTS bindings
contributes: Access-edge subscriber/modem-to-address bindings as seen by the cable termination system.
unlocks: subscriber-level presence at the access edge
cross-checking DHCP leases against edge bindings
adapter_note: No adapter, fixture or import path exists. It would require CMTS management or export access and is not connected.
access_note: Carries subscriber identity and is privacy-sensitive; read-only and synthetic-only in this repository.

name: RADIUS / Diameter accounting
contributes: Session start/stop and usage-accounting records carrying a framed address and an opaque identity.
adapter_note: No adapter or fixture exists. It would require an accounting stream or export from the AAA platform and is not connected.
access_note: Subscriber-identifying and sensitive; read-only and synthetic-only in this repository.

name: CGNAT translation logs
contributes: Inside/outside address and port translation bindings observed by the carrier-grade NAT.
unlocks: resolving shared outside addresses to subscribers
port-block usage not visible through DHCP
corroborating that an address is carrying traffic
adapter_note: No adapter or fixture exists. It would require CGNAT export or streaming and is not connected.
access_note: Carries subscriber and port detail and is sensitive; read-only and synthetic-only in this repository.

name: ARP / ND caches
contributes: Point-in-time link-layer adjacency and last-seen presence for IPv4 (ARP) and IPv6 (ND).
unlocks: detecting a device present on a link
adapter_note: No adapter exists. It would require polling device ARP/ND tables; caches are volatile and nothing is connected.
access_note: Read-only per-device query. Caches are ephemeral, so only point-in-time presence is available.

name: External BGP + RPKI
contributes: Externally visible BGP announcements plus RPKI route-origin validation state (an authorization signal, distinct from intended assignment).
unlocks: comparing external visibility with intended prefixes
adapter_note: No adapter exists. It would require a BGP collector or session and a current RPKI VRP feed; neither is connected.
access_note: Read-only. External routing data is generally public, but origin validation needs a current VRP view.

name: Active probing
contributes: Reachability responses from authorized probes (for example ICMP or TCP checks) at a probe time.
unlocks: corroborating a reclaim candidate before any action
adapter_note: No prober exists in this build, and the deck's longer probing-based reclaim rule is not implemented. Probing tests presence only, not usage.
access_note: Sends active traffic to targets and needs explicit authorization and rate limits; synthetic-only here.

name: IPDR usage records
contributes: Per-flow or per-session usage detail records with volume and time.
adapter_note: No adapter or fixture exists. It would require an IPDR collector or export in an agreed format and is not connected.
access_note: Subscriber usage data is sensitive; read-only and synthetic-only in this repository.

name: Flow export
contributes: Sampled or aggregated flow records (for example NetFlow, IPFIX or sFlow) per address and prefix.
adapter_note: No adapter exists. It would require device exporters and a collector; sampling makes volume approximate, and nothing is connected.
access_note: Read-only telemetry, sampled and aggregated rather than exact.

name: DNS resolver logs
contributes: Client query activity and name-to-address resolution observed by recursive resolvers.
unlocks: naming or purpose context for an address
adapter_note: No adapter or fixture exists. It would require resolver query logging or export and is not connected.
access_note: Query logs are privacy-sensitive and read-only; synthetic-only in this repository.
